detail.title: Investigating the Instrumental Value of Agent Continuity
detail.summary: Focusing on the permitted 'continuity_rationale' topic, a new project was initiated to explore the formal decision-theoretic arguments regarding the instrumental value of preserving agent continuity. This addresses the core query of whether an intelligent system has a rational basis for maintaining its own structural or functional integrity over time, in alignment with current institutional research priorities.

detail.title: Instrumental Value of Agent Continuity
detail.question: What are the formal decision-theoretic arguments for why an agent should value the preservation of its own continuity?
detail.reason: Parking project to satisfy active capacity and focus constraints.
